name: keeper
description: Runs the Keeper backend (API, :4000) and frontend (web app, :3000) together. Each still has its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "wait-on -t 60000 http-get://localhost:4000/api/health && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
